subject: Exec sponsor ownership handoff + EB meeting windowing for Helix close
messages:
From: Sarah Liu <sarah.liu@helixsystems.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 09 Nov 2025 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Aligning exec sponsor + EB availability for close plan

Hi Marcus,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the team was very impressed with the latency profiling and the dedicated routing options. Procurement asked me to kick off an explicit mutual action plan so we can lock in timelines and the exec board (EB) meeting slot that our CFO will need to attend.

Quick context: Helix wants a go/no-go decision on vendor selection by the week of Dec 8. Our exec sponsor (CFO) has a tight board calendar; she asked that any EB-level conversation be limited to 30 minutes and focus on SLOs, data residency, and cost runway.

Can you:
- Confirm who at Redwood will be the exec sponsor for Helix (we expect a VP/above)
- Share a short draft MAP so we can align dependencies and owners
- Propose two EB time windows (30 min) the week of Dec 1 or Dec 8 — we will try to accommodate the earlier slot if possible

I attached our internal timeline to this message and included our procurement alias for scheduling.

Appreciate it,
Sarah

Attachment: Helix_Timeline_v1.pdf (pdf)

From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Liu <sarah.liu@helixsystems.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 10 Nov 2025 10:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Aligning exec sponsor + EB availability for close plan

Sarah —

Thanks for the clear ask and timeline. I'll be the primary Redwood lead on the MAP operationally; for EB-level presence I'd like to propose Marissa Cole (SVP, GTM) as the exec sponsor and Monica Patel (Head, Customer Success) to join for the EB Q&A. Marissa oversees strategic partnerships and has led multiple enterprise closes with finance/c-suite teams.

Draft plan actions I can share now:
- Redwood: finalize MAP owners (Marissa, Marcus) and deliver technical evaluation notes by Nov 20
- Helix: provide final list of compliance questions and expected data residency regions by Nov 18
- Joint: schedule EB slot (30 min) — target windows below

Proposed EB windows (all PST):
- Option A: Tue, Dec 2 — 09:30–10:00
- Option B: Thu, Dec 4 — 14:00–14:30
- Fallback: Tue, Dec 9 — 11:00–11:30

I attached a lightweight MAP template and an EB agenda draft for your review. If those windows look rough, we can expand to additional slots.

Best,
Marcus

Attachments: Helix_MAP_v2.xlsx (spreadsheet); EB_Agenda_DRAFT.pdf (pdf)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Liu <sarah.liu@helixsystems.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, procurement@helixsystems.com
Date: Wed, 12 Nov 2025 08:22:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Aligning exec sponsor + EB availability for close plan

Hi Sarah — happy to step in as exec sponsor for Helix. Thanks Marcus for pulling the draft MAP together. A few quick notes from my side:

1) EB focus areas: please keep the agenda to three bullets — 1) Security & compliance posture (SOC2 hits + residency), 2) Contract economics and committed throughput, 3) Migration/rollback guardrails. If procurement wants deeper T&C discussion, we can set a separate session with legal.

2) Time preference: our exec prefers mornings for short slots. Option A (Dec 2, 09:30) works best; she has another board invite on Dec 4. If we confirm Dec 2 I'll ask her EA to lock it and request calendar invites as 30-minute blocks.

3) MAP deliverables: Marcus — please add an explicit owner and completion date for the KV cache and quantization verification tasks.

Sarah — can your procurement alias confirm Dec 2 availability by EOD tomorrow? If we get that OK I will route the invite and include a one-pager for the EB.

Thanks,
Marissa
SVP, GTM 
Redwood Inference

From: Tom Alvarez <tom.alvarez@helixsystems.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Sarah Liu <sarah.liu@helixsystems.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, procurement@helixsystems.com
Date: Wed, 12 Nov 2025 16:04:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Aligning exec sponsor + EB availability for close plan

Marissa, Marcus —

Thanks — Dec 2 09:30 PST is good on our side. I've looped in procurement to confirm formal availability but the CFO can do the 30-minute EB slot then.

Next steps I will own:
- Procurement will send any final contract questions by Nov 18
- I'll upload the final attendee list and any board prep slides to the shared Drive link (will ping when uploaded)

Marcus — please confirm that the MAP file you attached will include hard owners and dates; we need that for our internal approval workflow.

Tom
VP, Finance Operations
Helix Systems
